data.situation:
A week later, two groups arrived for the same room. Within a few minutes, Lin found herself in a high-pressure situation at the desk: one organiser was pointing at an email while another kept checking the time. Lin did not know the answer immediately. She checked the internal booking notes and asked both organisers to wait while she found a solution. Jo: How did you manage to find another room so quickly?
Lin: I called the events team. They knew a smaller room was free.
Jo: You took the initiative instead of waiting for me.
Lin: I checked the room on my own initiative, but I asked before changing the booking. We needed cooperation from the other team. To the events team
Thank you for helping us deal with the double booking. Both groups are now in their rooms. Please keep today’s note with the booking records so we can understand how the error happened.

readingBlocks.en: A week later, two groups arrived for the same room. Within a few minutes, Lin found herself in a high-pressure situation at the desk: one organiser was pointing at an email while another kept checking the time. Lin did not know the answer immediately. She checked the internal booking notes and asked both organisers to wait while she found a solution.
readingBlocks.zh: 一周后，两组人来使用同一个房间。几分钟内，前台变得压力很大：一位组织者指着邮件，另一位不停看时间。林没有立刻知道答案。她查看内部预约记录，请两位组织者等候，自己去找解决办法。

readingBlocks.en:
Jo: How did you manage to find another room so quickly?
Lin: I called the events team. They knew a smaller room was free.
Jo: You took the initiative instead of waiting for me.
Lin: I checked the room on my own initiative, but I asked before changing the booking. We needed cooperation from the other team.
readingBlocks.zh:
乔：你怎么设法这么快找到另一间房的？
林：我打电话给活动团队，他们知道一间小房间空着。
乔：你主动采取行动，没有等我。
林：我自己主动去查看房间，但改预约前先征求了意见。我们需要另一团队的合作。

readingBlocks.en:
To the events team
Thank you for helping us deal with the double booking. Both groups are now in their rooms. Please keep today’s note with the booking records so we can understand how the error happened.
readingBlocks.zh:
致活动团队
谢谢帮助我们处理重复预约。两组人现在都在各自房间。请把今天的便条和预约记录放一起，便于了解错误是怎样发生的。

glossary.zh: 使人感到很大压力或焦虑的
glossary.note: high-pressure situation/job；连字符连接两个部分。
glossary.example: It was a high-pressure morning at the desk.
glossary.exampleZh: 前台度过了压力很大的上午。

externalEvidence.label: Cambridge Dictionary
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Selected work-related stress/worry, not forceful selling or physical atmospheric pressure.

glossary.zh: 组织内部的；内部使用的
glossary.example: Lin checks the internal booking notes.

externalEvidence.definition: occurring within an institution or community

glossary.note: manage to do something；这里不是管理人员或组织。
glossary.example: Lin managed to find another room.
glossary.exampleZh: 林设法找到了另一间房。

glossary.note: deal with a problem；过去式dealt with。
glossary.example: They deal with the double booking.

glossary.note: take the initiative to do something；强调率先行动。
glossary.example: Lin takes the initiative and calls the events team.
glossary.exampleZh: 林主动采取行动，给活动团队打电话。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Taking the initiative concerns acting first; on one’s own initiative concerns acting without being told.

glossary.zh: 出于自己的主动，而非他人要求
glossary.note: on one’s own initiative；按主语使用my/her/their等所有格。
glossary.example: She checked the room on her own initiative.
glossary.exampleZh: 她自己主动去查看了房间。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Taking the initiative concerns acting first; on one’s own initiative concerns acting without being told.

glossary.zh: 为共同目的相互协作；合作
glossary.example: They need cooperation from the events team.
glossary.exampleZh: 他们需要活动团队的合作。
